name: Ling-3.1-flash-base

lineage.how_derived: base checkpoint of Ling-3.1-flash after Warmup-Stable-and-Merge (WSM) checkpoint merging, trained in FP8, released in BF16

purpose: The card releases the base checkpoint to support research and community-driven innovation: continued pre-training, mid-training, SFT, preference optimisation and RL post-training, distillation research, long-context and MoE systems research. It states it is not recommended as-is for end-user chat or production without post-training.

license.name: MIT (card tag; no LICENSE file in the repository)
license.notes: Card YAML and the card's License section say MIT; raw/main/LICENSE returns 404 (2026-11-19), so no licence text was read.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear attention MoE (KDA + gated MLA), same as ling-3.1-flash
architecture.attention: 63 KDA layers and 9 gated MLA layers (7:1), 4 dense layers

variants.notes: no quantised repo found (HF API lists 0 derivatives, 2026-11-19)

pc-12gb.notes: 1144 GB BF16 and no quantised base

avoid_for: direct end-user chat or production without post-training (card)
soft.maturity: Released two weeks after the instruct model.

tona_fit.reason: A research base checkpoint at 1.14 TB BF16 with no quantised release; the instruct model (ling-3.1-flash) is the usable form and is itself out of reach for most classes.

sources.note: README with the 47-benchmark base table, file sizes via the HF API; LICENSE 404
